roleContext.jobDescription: A retail bank exposes account-information and payment-initiation APIs to licensed third-party providers under open-banking regulation. The API engineering squad builds the Java and Kotlin services behind those endpoints, keeps the consent flows aligned with the published standard and reports endpoint response times to the regulator every quarter. The engineer will add endpoints, profile and tune slow paths, keep the conformance test suite current and pair with the security team on certificate rotation. Performance improvements are reported against a recorded baseline taken from the API gateway's monitoring.

requirements.text: Builds and maintains Java or Kotlin services behind regulated open-banking endpoints, including payment-initiation endpoints.
Maintains automated conformance tests against the published open-banking standard.
Demonstrates a measured response-time improvement on an API path against a recorded baseline.
Works with the security team on mutual-TLS certificate rotation for third-party connections.
Holds a recognised Java developer certification.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Software Engineer, Open Banking APIs

## Experience

- Built the Kotlin service behind the account-balances endpoint at Harrowgate Building Society, including pagination, consent checks and mapping of internal errors to the standard's error codes.
- Kept the conformance test suite passing against each new version of the open-banking standard and added test cases for the variable recurring payments consent flow.
- Profiled the transactions-history endpoint and replaced a per-row consent lookup with a cached consent snapshot, then worked with the API gateway team to compare response times before and after the change.
- Joined the quarterly certificate rotation with the security team, updating the trust-store configuration for third-party provider connections and checking the handshake logs afterwards.
- Wrote the runbook for re-issuing expired consents and walked the squad's engineering guild through it.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the pull request for the cached consent snapshot (diff and description), showing the cache invalidation rules, unit tests for revoked consents and review comments from two engineers.
